The agency director announced today that Dr. Helen Park has been named chief of staff, effective immediately. Dr. Park, a physician-scientist and longtime public servant, most recently served as deputy director for policy, where she coordinated the agency’s response to several public health emergencies. In her new role she will advise the director on strategic priorities, manage the flow of information across the agency’s offices, and represent leadership in discussions with external partners. “Helen has a rare combination of scientific credibility and operational skill,” the director said. “She understands how to turn good ideas into programs that work.” Dr. Park earned her medical degree at a state university and completed a fellowship in infectious diseases. She succeeds a colleague who is returning to academic research after four years of service.
